_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); analog semiconductor signals; the listing and short-history bounds rules (AVGO)

pit_profile.why: Broadcom: 'We are a global technology leader that designs, develops and supplies a broad range of semiconductor and infrastructure software solutions', 'Through our fiscal year ended November 4, 2018, or fiscal year 2018, we had four reportable segments: wired infrastructure, wireless communications, enterprise storage, and industrial & other', and 'We operate a primarily outsourced manufacturing business model' (its own FY2018 10-K); 'The global semiconductor market is highly competitive', and 'We operate in the highly cyclical semiconductor industry, which is subject to significant downturns': a cyclical and competitive risk, not an obsolescence one

theme_watch.reason: Live: the company's own FY2018 10-K says 'the shift to cloud-based IT solutions and services, such as hyperscale computing, which may adversely affect the timing and volume of sales of our products for use in traditional enterprise data centers'. At the same time it sells into data centers itself: 'We offer a broad set of Ethernet switching and routing products that are optimized for data center implementations'. The stock trades at 68.6x FY19E — a premium. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (CLOUD) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing cloud substitution of its enterprise storage and networking specifically.

classification.quality_note: Broadcom: 'We are a global technology leader that designs, develops and supplies a broad range of semiconductor and infrastructure software solutions', 'Through our fiscal year ended November 4, 2018, or fiscal year 2018, we had four reportable segments: wired infrastructure, wireless communications, enterprise storage, and industrial & other', and 'We operate a primarily outsourced manufacturing business model' (its own FY2018 10-K); 'The global semiconductor market is highly competitive', and 'We operate in the highly cyclical semiconductor industry, which is subject to significant downturns': a cyclical and competitive risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; +304% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.97; conservative 2yr -69%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -2.7%/yr (worst year FY10-FY17 ex-FY14 ex-FY16, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS -12.4%/yr (FY19 guide on FY18 + margin + buyback); P/E at its 9.3-yr ex-FY14 ex-FY16 ex-FY18 median

BULL.desc: EPS +13.2%/yr (FY10-FY17 ex-FY14 ex-FY16 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +50.3%/yr (best 2-yr run FY10-FY17 ex-FY14 ex-FY16, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: AVGO (retrospective, 2019-02-22) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B infx (83.3% downside to Bear $46.22 / -51.8% upside to Bull $133.39) | Adj composite 2.50 vs market 3.47: gap -0.97 [OVERVALUED] | +304% above the EPP floor $68.51 (17x FY19E $4.03) | Conservative 2-yr case: -68.8% total (-34.4%/yr) | At 68.6x FY19E the 15% hurdle price $365.67 sits above the BULL case; net revenue +12.4% YoY in Q4 FY18, forward revenues +17.5% (FY19 revenue guide (Q4 FY18 release)); cloud is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
